description: Revenue, net income, total assets, total liabilities, stockholders’ equity and cash from the XBRL data a company filed with the SEC, by calendar-year frame (up to 3 years), in US dollars.

cik.description: SEC CIK, leading zeros optional, e.g. "320193".

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. "AAPL" (used when cik is empty).

name: get_financials
title: XBRL totals of a company
